Editorial Works

Essays published on this site and articles written for other publications. Filter by topic or publication.

Most of the older pieces here date from my years as an editor in the space sector (2015–2021), including Spaceoneers. From 2021 to 2023 I led communications for ESA Business Applications at HE Space, and since 2023 my writing has come out of my own consultancy.See the full career timeline.
